projects.title: Python Student Management System
projects.subtitle: Your first complete application
projects.purpose: Turn Python knowledge into a usable command-line student records application. Practice validation, persistence and modular code before introducing AI libraries.
milestones: Define the student record schema and validation rules.
Implement create, update, delete and search as independently tested functions.
Add a repository interface and JSON file persistence with safe error handling.
Build the CLI, exercise malformed input and document usage.
projects.deployment: Run locally in a documented virtual environment. Publish source and tests to a repository; no cloud service is required.
projects.result: A command-line program that persists valid student records and survives invalid input.

projects.title: Data Analysis and ML Prediction
projects.subtitle: From raw data to a defensible prediction
projects.purpose: Analyze a public dataset, build a simple prediction baseline and explain what the evaluation does and does not establish.
milestones: Choose a licensed public dataset and define a prediction target.
Split data before fitting preprocessing; profile quality and possible leakage.
Fit a baseline and a second model using a preprocessing pipeline.
Evaluate on held-out data, inspect errors and save the full pipeline.
projects.deployment: Keep a reproducible notebook and dependency file. Save model artifacts with training metadata and the data license.
projects.result: A reproducible analysis and model with measured held-out results and documented limitations.

projects.title: ML Prediction API
projects.subtitle: Give your model a reliable interface
projects.purpose: Expose a trained model through a validated Python API with predictable input, output and failure behavior.
milestones: Define request and response schemas with boundary cases.
Load the complete saved pipeline once and expose a prediction route.
Add health checks, structured errors and request logs.
Test valid, invalid and failing requests; package and document the service.
projects.deployment: Use an ASGI host or container platform with environment configuration, health checks and a private model artifact.
projects.result: A documented prediction API with validation and meaningful integration tests.

projects.title: RAG Document Assistant
projects.subtitle: Answers grounded in your documents
projects.purpose: Build a document assistant that retrieves authorized evidence, answers with sources and admits when the corpus cannot answer.
milestones: Collect permitted documents and preserve source IDs during parsing.
Implement chunking, embeddings and tenant-aware storage.
Build retrieval and a generation adapter with source references.
Evaluate answerable and unanswerable questions; test denied access and ingestion failure.
projects.deployment: Store provider credentials only on the server. Use protected object storage, durable metadata and a background worker for ingestion.
projects.result: A PDF-capable assistant with traceable sources, permission-filtered retrieval and an evaluation report.

projects.title: Graph RAG Knowledge Assistant
requirements: Combine graph and vector retrieval where useful
projects.subtitle: Follow the connections between ideas
projects.purpose: Compare relationship-aware retrieval with a vector baseline on questions requiring connected evidence. Document where the graph does not help.
milestones: Select a small corpus with explicit relationship questions.
Extract and resolve entities, preserving provenance on every edge.
Implement bounded graph retrieval and optionally combine vector candidates.
Compare recall, answer support, latency and extraction errors against the baseline.
projects.deployment: Configure private graph access, backups and source deletion propagation. Record extraction cost and graph maintenance requirements.
projects.result: A measured graph-assisted retrieval experiment with inspectable nodes, edges and source provenance.

projects.title: CCAI Intelligent Model Router
projects.subtitle: The flagship · Centralized Contextual AI
projects.purpose: Build CCAI: a platform that classifies requests and chooses a suitable model using capability, context length, quality, cost, latency and provider availability.
milestones: Define a task taxonomy, evaluation set and model capability registry.
Build authenticated request intake, provider adapters and a deterministic routing baseline.
Enforce context limits, token budgets, tenant quotas and atomic usage accounting.
Add bounded retries, fallback, request history and routing decision logs.
Compare routing quality, cost and latency against a fixed-model baseline.
Harden secrets, permissions, observability and deployment; document architecture decisions.
projects.deployment: Use your own provider credentials or mocked adapters. Deploy behind TLS with per-user access policies, database migrations and monitoring. The learning website itself needs no paid model API.
projects.result: A functioning, evaluated multi-provider router with honest cost and reliability measurements.

projects.title: Production-Ready Scalable AI Platform
projects.subtitle: A system you can operate with confidence
projects.purpose: Turn a working AI backend into a secure, observable service whose capacity and recovery behavior are measured and documented.
milestones: Define service-level objectives and document a modest expected workload.
Add tenant isolation, distributed limits, queue idempotency and fallback.
Create container builds, CI checks and a repeatable deployment pipeline.
Instrument logs, traces, metrics and actionable alerts.
Run small controlled load and failure tests, then test backup restoration.
Publish environment-specific latency, errors, throughput, CPU and memory results.
projects.deployment: Choose one cloud provider. Restrict IAM, configure budgets and backups, separate environments and prove rollback before expanding traffic.
projects.result: A deployable platform with a reproducible capacity report, security tests and recovery playbook. No unsupported million-request claims.
